maddeler.e:
انخرقت (form VII)
# اِنْخَرَقْتُ (inḵaraqtu) /in.xa.raq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# اِنْخَرَقْتَ (inḵaraqta) /in.xa.raq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# اِنْخَرَقْتِ (inḵaraqti) /in.xa.raq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْخَرَقَ (inḵaraqa)
# اِنْخَرَقَتْ (inḵaraqat) /in.xa.ra.qat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
